name: pstack-zcode
description: The complete pstack collection for ZCode (Lauren @poteto's workflow, adapted): all 54 skills plus an optional resident-mode SessionStart hook, off by default. Installing this plugin installs everything; the npx skills route stays available for skills-only installs.

description_i18n.zh-CN: pstack 全家桶（Lauren @poteto 工作流的 ZCode 适配版）：54 个技能 + 可选常驻模式 SessionStart 钩子（默认关闭）。装本插件即装齐全部；只要技能的走 npx skills 通道。

residentSummary.title: Resident mode (poteto-mode summary)
residentSummary.description: When on, every new session starts with the condensed poteto-mode summary injected (~300 tokens). Off by default; the npx skills route never injects.
